name: get_device_logcat
description: Retrieve Android logcat logs from a connected Meta Quest device via ADB. This is the primary tool for debugging device issues, app crashes, and system problems. Key use cases include debugging app crashes, investigating performance issues, monitoring system events, tracking application behavior, and analyzing connectivity issues.

buffer.description: Log buffer to read from: main, system, crash, radio, events, all, default

clear.description: Whether to clear existing logs before retrieving new ones

format.description: Output format: brief, long, process, raw, tag, thread, threadtime (default), time

level.description: Minimum log level to filter by (V=Verbose, D=Debug, I=Info, W=Warning, E=Error, F=Fatal)

lines.description: Number of log lines to retrieve from the device (default: 1000)

package.description: Filter logs by specific package name (e.g., 'com.oculus.vrshell')

pid.description: Filter logs by specific process ID

regex.description: Regex pattern to filter log messages

tag.description: Filter logs by specific tag (e.g., 'Unity', 'System'). Use None for all tags
